newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume fell to 1.2 billion yuan from 1.9 billion yuan on Wednesday, with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said the rates moved narrowly in very dull trading today with only a handful of financial institutions building positions to cope with the on-going annual audit by the central bank.
"Many securities houses and brokerages lent out money on the market today after withdrawing from the A share markets during its recent falls," one trader said.
Traders believe the rates would continue to move in a narrow range on thin volumes for the rest of this year.
